environment.description: Go microservice deployed on EKS (Kubernetes 1.28) in a VPC with default security groups. Pod runs with default service account. pgBouncer sidecar in transaction pooling mode on localhost:6432 connecting to RDS PostgreSQL. No network policies applied to the namespace. Pod has unrestricted egress and can reach the EC2 instance metadata service (IMDS v1 enabled on nodes), internal services, and the RDS instance directly.
